summary:
Complete master strategy document for the Amazon ML Challenge 2026 - Business Entity Resolution. Covers:

1. Problem analysis with verified EDA insights (24.2M records, cross-script matching, 5.58% singletons, F₀.₅ scoring math)
2. 4-stage cascading pipeline architecture: Preprocessing → Multi-channel Blocking → Feature Engineering (50+ features) → LightGBM classifier → Precision-tuned decisions
3. Critical cross-script transliteration strategy for Hindi/Tamil/Telugu using IndicXlit
4. Multi-channel blocking (TF-IDF char n-grams + multilingual-e5 dense embeddings + phonetic) targeting ≥99% recall
5. LightGBM pairwise classifier with hard negative mining and F₀.₅ threshold optimization
6. France zero-shot strategy using language-agnostic features
7. Singleton detection guardrails
8. 5-phase experimentation roadmap (MVP → Cross-Script → Features → France → Ensemble)
9. Computational resource planning (15GB RAM, CPU/GPU strategies)
10. Risk mitigation matrix
11. Software stack and expected performance targets (0.91+ F₀.₅)
